_description: Deterministic evidence chain. One entry per rule-driven pipeline step (gate verdict, CSV check, regex match, render step, probe result). Designed as evidence for the deterministic-conformance regime (EAA Directive 2019/882); the Level 2 tagged PDF and per-page accessibility verdicts come from these steps. Adjacent on disk only; the artefact frontmatter does NOT embed a pointer to this file (the .ai.json companion is the regulator-facing one).
